# target_ct bytes from address 0x402060
target_ct = bytes([0xfd, 0x4d, 0x0c, 0xc9, 0xae, 0x33, 0xdc, 0x40,
                   0xe5, 0x89, 0x25, 0x9a, 0x55, 0xe0, 0x6b, 0x19,
                   0xa9, 0x2b, 0x94, 0x1c, 0x56, 0xa0, 0xf8, 0x7d])

# The algorithm:
# edx starts at 0xffffffbb (which is -69 as signed, or 0xBB as a byte when masked to 8 bits)
# For each position i:
#   char = input[i]
#   check if (edx ^ char) == target_ct[i]
#   if match: edx = edx + char
# 
# To reverse: char = edx ^ target_ct[i], then edx = edx + char

result = []
edx = 0xffffffbb  # starting value

for i in range(24):
    # The XOR uses only lower 8 bits (sil register = lowest 8 bits of esi)
    # (edx ^ char) & 0xff == target_ct[i]
    # So: char = (edx & 0xff) ^ target_ct[i]
    char = (edx & 0xff) ^ target_ct[i]
    result.append(char)
    edx = (edx + char) & 0xffffffff  # keep it 32-bit

decoded = bytes(result)
print(f"Decoded: {decoded}")
print(f"As string: {decoded.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')}")

target_ct = bytes([0xfd, 0x4d, 0x0c, 0xc9, 0xae, 0x33, 0xdc, 0x40,

candidate = b'FLAG{cobalt_quartz_6664}'
edx = 0xffffffbb

all_match = True
for i in range(24):
    char = candidate[i]
    esi = edx ^ char
    sil = esi & 0xff
    expected = target_ct[i]
    if sil != expected:
        print(f"Mismatch at position {i}: got {sil:#x}, expected {expected:#x}")
        all_match = False
    edx = (edx + char) & 0xffffffff

print(f"All match: {all_match}")
